contents:
Orilon Station
The Helix Gate at Orilon Station was designed by systems architect Mira Voss. It entered service in 2041 after a six-year construction program.

Kestrel Array
The Kestrel Array is calibrated at Nadir Laboratory. Its sealed calibration cells use the isotope Xenon-129.

Blue Cedar Mission
The Blue Cedar mission surveyed Arcturus Ridge with a fleet of 17 autonomous drones led by the vehicle Juniper One.

Solace Protocol
The Meridian Council approved the Solace protocol on 12 March 2038. The protocol defines emergency communication rules for deep-sea habitats.

Ember Archive
The Ember Archive is located in Lydian Port. Its first curator was the historian Ivo Sen.

Quill Engine
Engineer Rhea Calder invented the Violet-7 coolant used by the Quill engine to remain stable during long burns.

Quartz Harbor Observatory
Quartz Harbor Observatory stands on Pelion Island. Its director is astronomer Hana Mirek.

Aurora Ledger
The Aurora Ledger writes an encrypted off-site backup every 19 minutes. The unusual cadence was selected to avoid synchronization with the station clock.
